entities.title: Page
entities.summary: The browser page: every screen for players and for the room's big screen, the draggable scale, the reconnecting connection, sound and shared text.
entities.purpose: Draws whatever View the room last sent and turns taps and drags into actions. The hash picks the screen: none for the front page, #CODE for a player's room, #CODE/skjar for a big screen. build.mjs bundles main.ts into dist/app.js.
boundaries: Never runs the rules: it only uses src/engine's types, limits and scoring bands, and the room decides every move.
Holds no secret but its own seat token, kept per room in localStorage.
